mapper.sql: v.visit_id, v.appointment_id, v.patient_id, v.employee_id, v.clinic_id, v.arrival_time, v.end_time, v.recorded_time, v.chief_complaint, v.diagnosis, v.status, p.full_name AS patient_name, p.phone AS patient_phone, e.full_name AS dentist_name, c.clinic_name, c.clinic_code, s.statement_no, s.status AS statement_status
JOIN patient p ON p.patient_id = v.patient_id JOIN employee e ON e.employee_id = v.employee_id JOIN clinic c ON c.clinic_id = v.clinic_id LEFT JOIN statement s ON s.visit_id = v.visit_id
mapper.select: SELECT vt.vt_id, vt.visit_id, vt.item_id, vt.tooth_code, vt.quantity, vt.consumed_units, vt.unit_price, vt.subtotal, vt.executed_time, t.item_name, t.standard_unit, t.contraindication FROM visit_treatment vt JOIN treatment_item t ON t.item_id = vt.item_id WHERE vt.visit_id = #{visitId} ORDER BY vt.vt_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visit (appointment_id, patient_id, employee_id, clinic_id, arrival_time, chief_complaint, diagnosis, status, recorded_time) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{patientId}, #{employeeId}, #{clinicId}, #{arrivalTime}, #{chiefComplaint}, #{diagnosis}, #{status}, #{recordedTime})

INSERT INTO visit_treatment (visit_id, item_id, tooth_code, quantity, consumed_units, unit_price, subtotal, executed_time) VALUES (#{visitId}, #{itemId}, #{toothCode}, #{quantity}, #{consumedUnits}, #{unitPrice}, #{subtotal}, #{executedTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE visit SET status = '已完成', end_time = #{endTime} WHERE visit_id = #{visitId}
UPDATE visit SET chief_complaint = #{chiefComplaint}, diagnosis = #{diagnosis} WHERE visit_id = #{visitId}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(arrival_time AS DATE) FROM visit WHERE visit_id = #{visitId}
